title: Tyrant
description: a mod introducing an identity system inspired by similar mods like Origins
body:
The mod currently adds an "identity" command system to the game for unique abilities and roles, intended to be used in the SMP "SupernovaSMP 2".

/setidentity allows you to set your identity and begin with the mod. Currently, only one WIP identity has been made: Yellowed.

More is planned, but is not being worked on at the moment.


The purpose of the mod is simple. Add cool features with an eldritch aspect to the game while desperately (and somehow) finding a way to make it all fit the overall theme.
